info.name: Finance Backend API
info.description:
Complete collection covering Auth, Financial Records, Dashboard, User Management, Permission Management, and Role Management.

**Quick start:**
1. Run **Login - admin** under Authentication.
2. All variables auto-populate: `adminToken`, `permissionId`, `roleId`, `userId`.
3. Every other request is ready to fire - no manual copy-paste needed.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: No JWT required for these endpoints.

response.name: 400 Validation error
response.body: { "error": "Validation failed", "message": "One or more fields have invalid values", "statusCode": 400, "fields": { "email": "Email must be valid" } }

exec: // Auto-fetch permissionId (first permission in the system)

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/permissions', method: 'GET', header: [{ key: 'Authorization', value: 'Bearer ' + json.token }] }, function(err, res) { if (!err && res.code === 200) { var p = res.json(); if (p && p.length > 0) pm.collectionVariables.set('permissionId', p[0].id); } });
// Auto-fetch roleId (first role in the system)

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/roles', method: 'GET', header: [{ key: 'Authorization', value: 'Bearer ' + json.token }] }, function(err, res) { if (!err && res.code === 200) { var r = res.json(); if (r && r.length > 0) pm.collectionVariables.set('roleId', r[0].id); } });
// Auto-fetch userId (first user in the system)

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/users', method: 'GET', header: [{ key: 'Authorization', value: 'Bearer ' + json.token }] }, function(err, res) { if (!err && res.code === 200) { var u = res.json(); if (u && u.length > 0) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', u[0].id); } });

item.name: Financial Records
item.description:
All requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{adminToken}}`.
Mutations (POST, PUT, DELETE) require ADMIN role.
GET endpoints are accessible by every authenticated role.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: All authenticated roles (VIEWER, ANALYST, ADMIN) can access all dashboard endpoints.

response.name: 200 OK - UserResponse (multi-role user now holds this role too)
409 Conflict - user already has this role
400 Bad Request - cannot revoke last role
response.body: { "error": "Bad Request", "message": "Cannot revoke the last role from a user", "statusCode": 400 }

response.body: { "error": "Not Found", "message": "User does not hold this role", "statusCode": 404 }

item.name: Permission Management
item.description: CRUD for permissions (ADMIN only). Permissions follow the format resource:action (e.g. records:read).

response.name: 400 Invalid name format
response.body: { "error": "Bad Request", "message": "Permission name must match format resource:action", "statusCode": 400 }

response.name: 409 Conflict - permission assigned to a role
response.body: { "error": "Conflict", "message": "Permission is assigned to one or more roles", "statusCode": 409 }

item.name: Role Management
item.description: CRUD for roles and their permission assignments (ADMIN only).

response.name: 200 OK - list of RoleResponse with permissions
200 OK - updated RoleResponse (now includes the permission)
409 Conflict - role assigned to users
response.body: { "error": "Conflict", "message": "Role is assigned to one or more users", "statusCode": 409 }
